categories.main_business_segments: Chang-Ho Fibre Corporation primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of various fibers, ultra-fine fibers, and dyed and finished fabrics. Their main products include high-performance woven fabrics for apparel, air-jet yarns, and other textile-related materials. The company focuses on functional textiles such as moisture-wicking, thermal insulation, abrasion-resistant, and eco-friendly fabrics, serving markets like outdoor sports, military, industrial applications, and fashion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile technologies including air-jet yarn production, digital management platforms, smart manufacturing, and composite lamination techniques. They emphasize eco-friendly processes such as waterless finishing, continuous corona treatment, plasma treatment, and chemical optimization. Their R&D focuses on sustainable materials like recycled fibers from PET bottles and fishing nets, as well as functional textiles with properties like waterproofing, breathability, and antimicrobial effects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chang-Ho serves international brand customers primarily in the apparel, outdoor sports, military, and industrial sectors. Their key markets include the United States, Europe, and Asia, with a strategic focus on expanding in the US and European markets. The company maintains strong relationships with global brands requiring high-quality, customized, and sustainable textile products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with production facilities including satellite factories in Southeast and South Asia to enhance supply chain flexibility. Their sales are predominantly export-oriented, with significant market presence in Asia (especially China), North America, and Europe. They are actively diversifying production away from China to Southeast Asia to mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chang-Ho operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on fiber processing, yarn production, fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing, and fabric customization. They integrate upstream raw material sourcing with downstream customer collaboration for product development, positioning themselves as a key supplier of functional and sustainable textile materials to brand manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing sustainable and eco-friendly textile materials, enhancing digital transformation and smart manufacturing, and developing high-performance functional fabrics. R&D initiatives focus on recycled and low-carbon raw materials, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and innovative composite materials. They also emphasize ESG integration, carbon footprint management, and compliance with international sustainability certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of high-value textile fabrics and yarns. The company also derives income from leasing non-core assets and foreign exchange gains. Their business model emphasizes customized orders, long-term contracts with international brands, and expanding sales channels through digital platforms and agent networks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chang-Ho positions itself as a leading supplier in the high-performance and sustainable textile segment, with competitive advantages in technology, product quality, and ESG compliance. Their competitors include other specialized textile manufacturers focusing on functional and eco-friendly fabrics. The company maintains strong market share in Taiwan’s textile export sector and holds a niche in supplying to premium international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.08 billion in the latest fiscal year, showing a 2.4% growth over the prior year. Profitability improved significantly with net income increasing over 200%, reflecting enhanced cost control and product mix optimization. Total assets reached about NT$2.94 billion with equity growing 16%, indicating a stable financial position and positive growth trajectory despite global market uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chang-Ho emphasizes high-quality, customized, and sustainable textile solutions that meet stringent international environmental and functional standards. Their value proposition includes advanced eco-friendly manufacturing processes, innovative functional fabric development, and strong ESG compliance with multiple global certifications. This differentiation enables them to serve premium brand customers seeking reliable, high-performance, and environmentally responsible textile products.
